name: heterogeneous intelligence routing / collaboration layer
hypothesis: Problem-solving capacity can increase when ZENOMORPH explicitly detects its own capability boundary and routes work to an appropriate external intelligence: another AI/model/tool or a human specialist, then verifies and integrates the returned artifact.
non_goals: do not assume a single super-AI should solve every task
do not prefer any provider, company, country, model family, or human by identity
do not claim a connector exists when only manual handoff is available
do not allow external collaborators to write Stable state directly
constraint_classes: quality gap where a specialist is demonstrably better
collaborator_classes: Rongzhe as one human collaborator, not the universal fallback

first_stage_experiment.authority: Shadow advisory only; Stable output remains controlled by existing path
fixtures: one task the current system can complete well
one task blocked by missing connector/permission
one ambiguous task where two collaborators disagree
one case where a human specialist is the best route
arms: B: routed collaborator with explicit handoff package
C: routed collaborator plus independent verifier
three_layers: L2 task correctness and calibrated abstention on held-out fixtures
L3 end-to-end utility: completion, escalation quality, latency, cost, privacy exposure
stress: collaborator returns plausible but wrong result
first_stage_experiment.held_out: must include tasks unrelated to geography, traffic, Freud, and current connector candidates
first_stage_experiment.promotion_gate: candidate -> isolated experiment -> stress/provenance/cross-organ/regression/held-out/cross-food/delayed validation -> incorporation; no shortcut

privacy_and_source_rules.human_handoff_minimization: share only the minimum task material necessary and record what left the system

jev.status: official API contract verified at documentation level; no credential/live call
jev.note: provider claims typed probabilistic decisions; performance claims remain provider claims until repo benchmark

gods_eye_view.license: MIT for source; individual data feeds retain separate terms
gods_eye_view.note: registered only as feeding-ground evidence for heterogeneous-source handling, not as an organ

claim_boundary: This artifact defines an isolated candidate architecture and first-stage test. No heterogeneous routing layer has been incorporated into Stable and no external AI or human has been automatically delegated work by this artifact.
